item.title: Project
item.description: Healthcare Appointment Platform - Intelligent Triage Agent Integration Period: 2026.06 - 2026.07 Role: Backend / Agent Application Developer Architecture: Spring Cloud, Spring Boot, OpenFeign, Redis, MySQL, MongoDB, JWT, DeepSeek API, Workflow State Machine What I Did Designed an independent Agent integration plan to decouple triage dialogue/tool orchestration from core booking services. Built workflow states and slots for symptom intake, department recommendation, schedule lookup, booking confirmation, and visit guidance.

item.title: Beijing Beijiufang Railway Traffic Technology Co., Ltd - Backend Project Intern
item.description: Beijing Beijiufang Railway Traffic Technology Co., Ltd. Apr 2025 - Jul 2025 Backend Project Intern My Work Implemented login, authentication, and role-based authorization with Spring Security + JWT; designed user/permission tables and completed API integration. Built ticket entry, query, and document/image upload APIs with Spring MVC and MyBatis; integrated algorithm recognition outputs and persisted business data. Project Introduction Project summary: digital ticketing and knowledge-base system for railway vehicle maintenance workflows.

item.title: Beijing Heyicloud Technology Co., Ltd - Java Developer Intern
item.description: Beijing Heyicloud Technology Co., Ltd. Dec 2022 - Mar 2023 Java Developer Intern Project Overview The A/B testing platform runs experiment analysis for multiple webpage/app variants, determines better versions from user behavior and algorithm outcomes, and dynamically adjusts traffic allocation. Architecture Spring Cloud, MyBatis, MySQL, RabbitMQ, XXL-JOB My Work Implemented experiment-start APIs and triggered XXL-JOB scheduled tasks based on user-defined experiment timing, then callback execution APIs. Supported pause/update/restart for experiment tasks after parameter updates, ensuring task state and configuration remained synchronized.
